title.narrative: Food aid to support families affected by the humanitarian crisis in the Republic of Ukraine

description.narrative: (141,000) beneficiaries received nutritional meals for 6 months

Providing food aid by distributing meals to government institutions in Ukraine. These institutions include orphanages, hospitals, and displacement centers, as the targets are the most vulnerable groups and those affected by the Ukrainian war.

• Contributing to reducing economic and living burdens • Improving the quality of living for vulnerable beneficiaries and overcoming the challenges that beneficiaries faced from the Ukrainian crisis • Providing meals, which will contribute to improving food security
